raw_anchor_layer.role: Decode original PDF text/line geometry for verbatim source anchoring; this layer alone does not establish table/header/footnote/caption semantic relationships.
raw_anchor_layer.meaning_of_recorded_no_table_association: A limitation inherited from the raw anchor, not a statement that the complete pipeline does no structural work.
raw_anchor_layer.line_order: Original backend textline order retained, not a human-certified multi-column reading order.

native_structure_layer.role: Docling native layout/table/reading-order candidates independently mapped to raw source spans. Processed native text never replaces literal quotations.
native_structure_layer.caption_unit_meaning: IN03 has two table-title caption units; no Figure caption or picture is claimed.

source_geometry_layer.meaning: These are restricted source-bound geometry checks, not universal table/page continuation inference or medical semantic approval.

whole_pipeline_limits.specific_IN03_partial_reason: Four ambiguous native-to-source mapping units; all3 pages and all270 task-scope blocks enumerated/processed. Summary failure is a separate task blocker.
whole_pipeline_limits.source_glyph_check: checked_no_detected_gaps; narrow heuristic, not all Unicode verified

candidate_classification_interpretation.root_ordinary_source_review: Separate delegated AI literal/source/context review; no human/clinical approval.
